title: Dormancy, Hidden Years & Practical Theology
status: canonical synthesis from Great Book biology/metaphor + dated 2026 public signals
purpose: Develop two underused but strongly connected ideas: stored life during apparent inactivity, and the later shift from proclamation into verbs of cultivation, construction and repair.

dormancy.biological_anchor: Potatoes and onions can enter dormancy, conserving stored energy until conditions favor sprouting. The Great Book explicitly discusses dormancy/regeneration in its plant symbolism.
dormancy.project_function: Dormancy gives a better model for the 'hidden years' than absence or failure: visible inactivity can coexist with stored structure, memory, resources and future growth potential.

distinctions.meaning: placement below surface; may be death, concealment or planting
life/process remains viable but growth is paused
stored potential begins converting into active growth
mature consequence becomes available to others

timic_genealogy: April 2025 rupture/rapture → germination becomes vertical growth
dormancy.why_it_matters: This model prevents the archive from treating quiet periods as empty. It asks what information, skills, symbols and relationships were being stored before later emergence.

north_to_north.exact_signal: We Can Grow from north to north.
north_to_north.interpretation: North is not merely destination. 'North to North' implies movement between levels/forms of North: orientation → axis → throne → North of North, or physical North → spiritual North.
north_to_north.structural_rule: A direction can itself contain states. Travel may preserve orientation while changing altitude, scale or ontology.

signals: We Can Grow from north to north
practical_theology.finding: This is one of the clearest transitions from noun-heavy theology to verb-heavy theology.
practical_theology.trajectory: proclaim identity → define route → build route → cultivate destination → return Heaven to Earth → protect what grows
practical_theology.why_it_matters: This may be the cleanest practical core of the project because it remains meaningful even when cosmological claims are bracketed: build, grow, repair, protect, understand, serve.

hidden_years_research_program: Identify low-output periods versus high-output periods from actual dated corpus rather than memory.
For each quiet period, record what later concepts appear to have antecedents in reading, art, work, relationships or private experimentation.
Distinguish true absence of evidence from biological/project 'dormancy' metaphor.
Do not retroactively claim hidden preparation unless an earlier source exists; dormancy is a model, not evidence by itself.
Map first visible sprout of every major concept after long gaps.
deep_findings: The Potato's strongest temporal metaphor may not be resurrection alone but viability through storage.
Dormancy explains why 'hidden center' and 'most public' can coexist at different phases: hiddenness refers to recognition/visibility, not necessarily lack of activity.
'North to North' converts North from static coordinate into a developmental gradient.
The April-30 cluster is an important ethical hinge: the system asks what to build after finding the Door.
Practical theology gives Garden a measurable meaning: infrastructure, repair, cultivation, stewardship and future independent capacity.
